title: Pathfinder artifact specification — shared contract
description: Carried by every artifact kind. schema_version, kind, artifact metadata, source identity, and the one citation shape. The kind discriminator selects the kind-specific schema and renderer.

schema_version.description: The contract version this specification is written against.

kind.description: The artifact kind. Selects the kind schema and the renderer. `lesson` and `diagram` are the supported kinds; anything else is refused rather than improvised.

artifact.description: Metadata about the artifact itself. Carries no presentation control: theme, colour, and layout belong to the renderer.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag, passed through to the document's lang attribute. Not a translation instruction.

source.description: Where the artifact's claims come from. `commit` is what evidence resolves against — never the working tree.

repo.description: Identifies the repository the evidence belongs to, so a diagnostic can say whose commit is missing.

commit.description: A full or abbreviated Git object name. Evidence resolves against this and nothing else.

generated_at.description: Supplied by the producer if it exists at all. Part of the deterministic input: the renderer never reads a clock.

citation.description: The one evidence shape, used identically wherever evidence appears, in this and every future kind.

path.description: Repository-relative, forward-slashed. Never absolute, never a machine path.

lines.description: Inclusive [start, end] line range, 1-based. Must lie within the file at the resolved commit.

commit.description: Overrides source.commit for this citation alone. Present when a claim is about a different point in history.

evidence.description: A list of citations. Emptiness is legal structurally and rejected by the evidence layer, so the failure is reported as the evidence claim it is.

identifier.description: A specification-supplied identifier. Every id the renderer emits is derived from one of these, never generated from ambient state.

prose.description: Plain-text paragraphs. Not Markdown and not HTML: the renderer escapes every character it emits.
